title: Pan-Seared Beef au Poivre with Zanzibari Sauce
description: A French-inspired dish featuring pan-seared beef in a spicy Zanzibari sauce, served with a side of savory stir-fried vegetables.

ingredients.name: beef
ingredients.notes: filet mignon or ribeye work well

ingredients.name: Zanzibari powder
ingredients.notes: or substitute with a combination of cumin and coriander

instructions: Season the beef with salt, pepper, and Zanzibari powder.
Heat butter in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the beef for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired doneness.
Transfer the beef to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
Reduce heat to medium and add garlic, onion, and bell pepper to the skillet.
Cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add tomato and stir-fry sauce to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve the beef with the Zanzibari sauce spooned over the top and garnished with parsley.
Cook time is approximate and may vary depending on the thickness of the beef and desired level of doneness.
